name: Uniroyal Industries Limited
about: Uniroyal Industries Limited manufactures and trades in garment accessories in India and internationally. The company offers woven labels, such as taffeta, damask, satin, and needle loom; printed labels comprising satin printed, cotton/polyester printed, and taffeta printed blends; hand tags, u-cards and inserts, and barcode stickers; gross grain, twill, woven, printed, jacquard, and cotton tapes; and woven and embroidered badges. It also provides plastic seals tags; packaging products comprising packaging and storage boxes, as well as paper carry, fabric hand, and carry bags; leather accessories consisting of leather badges and zipper pullers for garments; and normal and high-density silicon heat transfer products. In addition, the company markets spun polyester and cotton yarns. It serves the garment, home furnishing, footwear, and toy industries. The company was formerly known as Uniroyal Textile Industries Ltd. and changed its name to Uniroyal Industries Limited in October 2005. Uniroyal Industries Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Panchkula, India.
